title: Discover and build a workflow Actor

goal.title: What should your Actor do?
goal.description: Describe the desired output, data sources and constraints. Public read-only workflows supported.
goal.prefill: Collect a public website page and produce a short source-backed brief about the organization.
goal.default: Collect a public website page and produce a short source-backed brief about the organization.

mode.title: Plan or test
mode.description: Plan discovers tools and exports an untested project. Execute starts bounded paid tool runs after dependency review.

parametersJson.title: Sample inputs (JSON)
parametersJson.description: Optional sample inputs used by the planned workflow, for example a public URL.

candidateActorIds.title: Reviewed Actor IDs (optional)
candidateActorIds.description: Leave empty to discover Actors. To approve discovered dependencies, review them and provide their owner/name IDs in a new test run.

generatedName.title: Generated Actor name
generatedName.description: Name for the generated project. Deployment may update an existing Actor with the same name.

testBudgetUsd.title: Child PPE allocation (USD)
testBudgetUsd.description: Sum of declared child pay-per-event caps. Compute and AI charges are additional; not an all-in spending limit.

workflowJson.title: Approved workflow JSON (optional)
workflowJson.description: Paste the graph definition from a prior plan to test that exact workflow after review.
